arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: The pharmacy argues the law targets drug middlemen, not plan administrators.
The industry group argues the law compels ERISA plans to follow state procedures.
The pharmacy claims low reimbursements drive pharmacists out of business.
The industry group claims the law creates a thicket of varying state laws.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case determines whether states can set drug reimbursement prices for ERISA plans. It affects whether pharmacists can survive in communities with low reimbursement rates. It shapes the balance between state consumer protection and federal plan uniformity.
